# Stack

Header: `winui/ui/panels/Stack.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panels/Stack.hpp`.

Lays its children out in a single column or row, [`spacing`](#spacing) apart.

The panel owns its children ([add()](#add) takes a `unique_ptr` and hands back a non-owning observer). Each child is measured unbounded along the stack and gets the panel's full cross extent, where its own alignment places it. The declarative forms are [ui::VerticalStack](#uiverticalstack) and [ui::HorizontalStack](#uihorizontalstack).

Example: 
```cpp
auto  stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
stack->set_spacing(12.0f);
ui::TextControl* label = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Clicks: 0"));
ui::ButtonControl*    click = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Click me"));
click->on_click([label, n = 0]() mutable { label->set_text(std::format("Clicks: {}", ++n)); });
window.set_content(std::move(stack)); // the window takes ownership of the whole subtree

// The same tree, declared:
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{ .text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); }) },
        ui::Button{ .text = "Click me", .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; } },
    },
});
```

## `ui::VerticalStack`

A column of children. Builds a [ui::StackControl](#uistackcontrol) with vertical orientation.

Children are measured with unbounded height and stacked top to bottom; [`child_alignment`](#uiverticalstack-child_alignment) decides their horizontal placement (a child's own [`horizontal_alignment`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) still applies inside that).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing         = 12,
    .child_alignment = ui::Alignment::Leading,
    .margin          = ui::Thickness{24.0f},
    .content         = {
        ui::Text{.text = "Appearance", .role = ui::TextRole::Subtitle},
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); })},
        ui::HorizontalStack{.spacing = 8, .content = {
            ui::Button{.text = "Click me", .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; }},
            ui::Button{.text = "Reset",    .on_click = [&] { clicks = 0; }},
        }},
    },
});
```

```cpp

    .spacing, .child_alignment, .children_transitions, .background, .background_transition,
    .border_brush, .border_thickness, .corner_radius, .padding, .style, .margin, .width,
    .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .content
}
```

## `ui::HorizontalStack`

A row of children. Builds a [ui::StackControl](#uistackcontrol) with horizontal orientation.

The mirror of [ui::VerticalStack](#uiverticalstack): children stack left to right and [`child_alignment`](#uihorizontalstack-child_alignment) places them vertically.

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing         = 8,
    .child_alignment = ui::Alignment::Center,
    .content         = {
        ui::Icon{.source = ui::Symbol::Save},
        ui::Text{.text = "Unsaved changes"},
        ui::Button{.text = "Save", .on_click = [&] { save(); }},
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing, .child_alignment, .children_transitions, .background, .background_transition,
    .border_brush, .border_thickness, .corner_radius, .padding, .style, .margin, .width,
    .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .content
}
```

## `ui::StackControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`.

Lays its children out in a single column or row, [`spacing`](#spacing) apart.

The panel owns its children ([add()](#add) takes a `unique_ptr` and hands back a non-owning observer). Each child is measured unbounded along the stack and gets the panel's full cross extent, where its own alignment places it. The declarative forms are [ui::VerticalStack](#uiverticalstack) and [ui::HorizontalStack](#uihorizontalstack).

Example: 
```cpp
auto  stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
stack->set_spacing(12.0f);
ui::TextControl* label = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Clicks: 0"));
ui::ButtonControl*    click = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Click me"));
click->on_click([label, n = 0]() mutable { label->set_text(std::format("Clicks: {}", ++n)); });
window.set_content(std::move(stack)); // the window takes ownership of the whole subtree

// The same tree, declared:
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{ .text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); }) },
        ui::Button{ .text = "Click me", .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; } },
    },
});
```

### StackControl

```cpp
StackControl() = default
```

An empty vertical panel, no spacing, no background.

### StackControl

```cpp
StackControl(Orientation orientation)
```

An empty panel stacking in [`orientation`](#orientation).

### add

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add(std::unique_ptr<T> child)
```

Takes ownership of a child, appends it after the last one, and returns a non-owning observer to it. The panel is the sole owner, so the pointer is valid only while the child is in the panel. Invalidates layout.

### add

```cpp
template <SpecLike S>
Element* add(S&& spec)
```

The declarative overload: builds `spec` (or takes the node a [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec) holds) and adds it as [add()](#add) does a control. Returns the built node as an [Element](../tree/element.md), or nullptr for an empty [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec), which adds nothing; a spec's `.control` field gives a typed observer.

### insert

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* insert(std::size_t index, std::unique_ptr<T> child)
```

[add()](#add) at `index` (clamped to the end) instead of after the last child.

### children

```cpp
std::span<const std::unique_ptr<Element>> children() const
```

The children in stacking order (owned by the panel).

### remove

```cpp
bool remove(const Element* child)
```

Destroys `child` if it is one of this panel's. False when it is not. Any observer to it dangles afterwards. With an [AddRemoveTransition](../tree/element-transitions.md#struct-addremovetransition) in [children_transitions()](../tree/element.md#children_transitions), the child leaves visibly. It drops out of layout, input and the tab ring at once, fades out where it was, and is destroyed when the fade has played.

### orphan

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> orphan(const Element* child)
```

Takes `child` out of the panel alive and hands it back, for adding somewhere else. Focus inside it is cleared and it plays no exit transition. Null when it is not one of this panel's children.

### clear

```cpp
void clear()
```

Destroys every child, each one leaving as it does with [remove()](#remove).

```

float spacing() const

The gap between neighboring children, in DIPs; 0 by default.

### set_spacing

void set_spacing(float spacing)
```

Changes the gap; invalidates layout.

### background

```cpp
const std::optional<Color>& background() const
```

The background, filled behind the children; nullopt (the default) draws nothing. A [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) is a theme resource, re-read whenever it is drawn (ui/BackgroundBrush.hpp).

### background_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor background_resource() const
```

The theme resource the background follows, when [set_background(ThemeColor)](#set_background) set one.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(std::optional<Color> color)
```

A fixed background color (nullopt clears it); redraws.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(ThemeColor resource)
```

A theme-resource background, re-read on every theme change; redraws.

### background_transition

```cpp
const std::optional<BrushTransition>& background_transition() const
```

With a transition set, a later change of what the background draws (a new color, or a resource under a new theme) blends from the color on screen (Animation.hpp's [BrushTransition](../tree/brush-transition.md)). nullopt (the default) changes it at once.

### set_background_transition

```cpp
void set_background_transition(std::optional<BrushTransition> transition)
```

Sets or clears the transition used by later background changes.

### border_brush

```cpp
std::optional<Color> border_brush() const
```

The outline color; nullopt (the default) draws no border even with a non-zero [border_thickness()](#border_thickness). Nullopt as well while a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) is set.

### border_brush_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor border_brush_resource() const
```

The theme resource the border is drawn from, or null.

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(std::optional<Color> color)
```

A fixed outline color; replaces any resource. Redraws.

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(ThemeColor resource)
```

An outline color read from the theme each time it is drawn; replaces any fixed color. Redraws.

### border_thickness

```cpp
const Thickness& border_thickness() const
```

The border width in DIPs per side (default zero); it insets the children like padding.

### set_border_thickness

```cpp
void set_border_thickness(const Thickness& thickness)
```

Sets the border width; updates the layout and redraws.

### corner_radius

```cpp
float corner_radius() const
```

The corner radius in DIPs, uniform for all four corners (default 0, square). It rounds the background and the border; the children are not clipped.

### set_corner_radius

```cpp
void set_corner_radius(float radius)
```

Sets the corner radius; redraws.

### padding

```cpp
const Thickness& padding() const
```

The room in DIPs between the border and the children (default zero).

### set_padding

```cpp
void set_padding(const Thickness& padding)
```

Sets the padding and updates the layout.

### child_alignment

```cpp
Alignment child_alignment() const
```

How children are placed across the stack. With [Stretch](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#stretch), the default, every child gets the panel's full cross extent and its own [horizontal_alignment()](../tree/element.md#horizontal_alignment) / [vertical_alignment()](../tree/element.md#vertical_alignment) positions it within that. Leading, Center and Trailing place every child at its desired cross size, and a child's own alignment then has no effect.

### set_child_alignment

```cpp
void set_child_alignment(Alignment a)
```

Changes [child_alignment()](#child_alignment); invalidates layout.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring touches only the panel and its children.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Lists the children in stacking order.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Measures each child unbounded along the stack and bounded across it, caching the sizes; returns their sum along the stack (plus spacing) by the largest across.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places the children one after another from the cached sizes, aligned per [child_alignment()](#child_alignment).

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Fills the background, then renders every child in order.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances the background and exit transitions, then ticks every child.

## Aliases

### VerticalStackControl

```cpp
using ui::VerticalStackControl = StackControl
```

The control a [`ui::VerticalStack`](#uiverticalstack) builds: a [StackControl](#uistackcontrol) whose orientation is Vertical.

### HorizontalStackControl

```cpp
using ui::HorizontalStackControl = StackControl
```

The control a [`ui::HorizontalStack`](#uihorizontalstack) builds: a [StackControl](#uistackcontrol) whose orientation is Horizontal.
